landing.heroTitle: Pick your field. Find rotations that fit your climate.

landing.trustPoint1Desc: Satellite-derived precipitation, soil moisture, and temperature histories.
landing.trustPoint2Desc: Every rotation card displays the exact data signals and sources behind its rank.
landing.trustPoint3Desc: Designed for mid-range phones, unstable connectivity, and clear decisions.

signals.low_water_demand_winter: Mustard requires 60% less water than dry-season boro rice.
signals.legume_nitrogen_boost: Mungbean naturally fixes atmospheric nitrogen in the soil before monsoon rice.
signals.monsoon_rainfed_monsoon: Aman rice relies on monsoon rains, avoiding groundwater pumping.
signals.moderate_water_winter: Wheat consumes moderate irrigation while providing strong staple grain security.
signals.high_market_value: High local market price yields strong cash return.
signals.legume_soil_recovery: Pulse inter-season rotation restores depleted topsoil organic matter.
signals.pulse_nitrogen_fixation: Lentil acts as a low-cost, protein-rich nitrogen fixer.
signals.low_irrigation_cost: Reduces fuel and electricity pumping expenses significantly.
signals.soil_microbiome_benefit: Promotes beneficial microbial diversity in sandy loam soils.
signals.heavy_groundwater_extraction: Boro paddy requires heavy groundwater pumping during drought-prone months.
